verdict.rationale: Ente Auth documents item-level deletion: codes go to a Trash section where they can be recovered or permanently deleted, and unparseable codes can be viewed and deleted. It also offers some retention control through an offline mode that keeps codes only on the device. However, nothing in the pack documents account deletion, removal of server-side synced backups, or retention periods for cloud or trash data. Missing for 10: account and cloud-data deletion, documented server-side retention policy or trash expiry, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: You can recover codes from here, in case of accidental deletions, or delete them permanently.
You can delete or edit a code by long pressing (or right clicking on desktop) on that item.
Added a way to view and delete Auth codes that could not be parsed.
In offline mode, your codes are stored only on that device.
